aws.review.configuration.selected_conten.title: Selected AWS configuration literals have no detected secrets
aws.review.configuration.selected_conten.description: Inspect only explicitly selected returned AWS configuration literals using both offline detectors and exact native read provenance.
aws.review.configuration.selected_conten.remediation: Remove exposed credential literals from the selected configuration and rotate confirmed exposed credentials. Prefer scoped workload identities or appropriate secret references.
aws.review.configuration.selected_conten.purpose: No credential verification, runtime execution, referenced secret-store content, all-resource or historical-configuration claim.
aws.review.configuration.selected_conten.missing_observation: The selected AWS configuration content was unreadable, unsupported, incomplete or unbound. Secret absence could not be assessed.
aws.review.configuration.selected_conten.pass_observation: Both offline detectors completed without detecting a supported secret in the selected AWS configuration content. Coverage is limited to the returned literal values.
aws.review.configuration.selected_conten.fail_observation: A likely secret was detected in the selected AWS configuration content. Its value is hidden; offline detection did not validate the credential.
